scope: Independent source-level semantic, formal, and Classical-Arabic audit of OLP-0701 through OLP-0722, followed by application and revalidation of the three evidenced Classical-only wording repairs. Every frozen English source, frozen MSA file, and current Classical target was read and compared. No MSA source, batch receipt, central overlay, configuration, TeX artifact, state log, or publication was changed.

authority_snapshot.role: governing Classical-Arabic style and invariant contract
immutable unit ordering and frozen source identities
producer receipt consulted only after independent reading; not treated as semantic proof
inherited Arabic terminology-token inventory; supplies effective denumerable wording

method.semantic_reading: All 22 English/MSA/Classical triples were read in source form. Definitions, hypotheses, conditionals, negations, quantifier scope, rule names, proof trees, examples, exercises, references, and editorial qualifications were compared as applicable.
method.formal_check: Displayed sequents and rule tables were compared branch by branch. Formula-sensitive defects in the frozen English that both Arabic witnesses already repair are catalogued separately so that a later synchronizer does not revert them.
method.classical_style_test: Applied STYLE_SPEC: coherent scholarly Arabic, explicit logical transitions, no meaning-changing ornament, and preservation of formal distinctions. The current Classical prose is generally idiomatic and not merely a sentence-order copy of the MSA.
method.terminology_review: Non-routine or internally variable terms were logged with exact source-line locators, the current choice, alternatives, rationale, and a concrete expert question. No claim of dictionary absence is made.
method.meaning_of_pass: PASS means that this bounded source reading found no further semantic or formal defect. It is not a rendered-page result, a global terminology certification, or machine-checked proof verification.
method.page_locator_policy: Stable printed page numbers do not exist at this source-only stage and TeX was explicitly out of scope. Target path plus one-based line numbers are therefore the authoritative locators; a later release build may add page numbers without replacing these source locators.

verification.formula_invariant_note: The bounded full-batch validator was rerun after the repairs and reported no environment-sequence, protected reference/key, import, literal/program block, proof-command, terminology-inventory, ordered formula-segment, or formal-token failure. Its nonzero status records only that no structural-review registry was supplied on that invocation; the two structural units are independently disposed below.

findings.pre_repair_target_quote: وأما القواعد الأربع المختلفة بين النظامين ... فإن كانت R قاعدة إضعاف ... وإن كانت قاعدة تقلص
findings.post_repair_target_quote: وأما القواعد المنطقية الأربع المختلفة بين النظامين ... فإن كانت R قاعدة إضعاف ... وإن كانت قاعدة تقلص
findings.issue: Before repair, the count four applied to the four differing logical-rule schemata (conjunction-left, disjunction-right, universal-left, existential-right), not to every rule differing between G1c and G3c; weakening and contraction are then treated separately. Without المنطقية the sentence overstated the scope of the count.
findings.proposed_minimal_repair: Replace «وأما القواعد الأربع المختلفة بين النظامين» with «وأما القواعد المنطقية الأربع المختلفة بين النظامين». Preserve the four cases and the following weakening/contraction clauses.
findings.applied_repair: Inserted «المنطقية» before «الأربع» and added adjacent key comment REVIEW-0713-M1 in both Arabic layers. The 2026-09-05 acceptance follow-up completed the formerly Classical-only repair in MSA without changing formulas or the four simulated logical-rule cases.

findings.pre_repair_target_quote: فإذا كانت f ... تقابلية، لم تكن تشاكلًا إلا إذا تحقق ...
findings.post_repair_target_quote: فإذا كانت f ... تقابلية، كانت تشاكلًا متى تحقق ...
findings.issue: Before repair, the frozen English said that the displayed preservation biconditionals suffice for a bijection to be an isomorphism, and the MSA retained that direction. The Classical phrase لم تكن ... إلا إذا presented them only as necessary conditions.
findings.proposed_minimal_repair: Replace «لم تكن تشاكلًا إلا إذا تحقق» with «كانت تشاكلًا متى تحقق». Do not change the three displayed biconditionals.
findings.applied_repair: Replaced the conditional phrase exactly as proposed and added adjacent key comment REVIEW-0717-N1; all three biconditionals were preserved.

findings.pre_repair_target_quote: لزم z∈X ولزم أيضًا z∈X∪Y. فبالأولى z∈X، وهو المطلوب.
findings.post_repair_target_quote: لزم z∈X ولزم أيضًا z∈X∪Y. وبخاصة z∈X، وهو المطلوب.
findings.issue: Before repair, the last step selected one already-derived conjunct; it was not an a-fortiori inference. The English says ‘in particular’ and the MSA says وعلى وجه الخصوص. فبالأولى misnamed the proof move and needlessly repeated the conclusion.
findings.proposed_minimal_repair: Replace «فبالأولى» with «وبخاصة» (or «ومن ذلك»), leaving the formula and the remainder of the sentence unchanged.
findings.applied_repair: Replaced «فبالأولى» with «وبخاصة» and added adjacent key comment REVIEW-0721-N1; the formulas and proof structure were preserved.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English invertibility proof omits the G3c nullary/bottom initial case.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Both Arabic witnesses explicitly include the case.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Add the nullary/bottom initial-sequent case before the inductive rule cases.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen English chooses eigenvariable c only outside Delta although the inversion lemma requires freshness for Gamma, Delta, and the quantified formula.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic imposes the full freshness condition.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Require c not to occur in Gamma, Delta, or the quantified formula.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English principal universal-right inference is labelled existential-right.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic uses the universal-right label.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Change RightR(exists) to RightR(forall) on that inference.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English contraction/existential-right derivation drops the argument (t) from B(t).
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic consistently retains B(t).
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Restore (t) on every affected occurrence in the derivation.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen English assigns Gamma the right-premise formula C→(D→E) instead of the left-premise formula (C∧D)→E.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic assigns the correct left-premise context.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Set Gamma={(C∧D)→E} in this rule instance.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The first combined proof tree labels an implication-left step as implication-right.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic uses the implication-left label.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Change the rule label from implication-right to implication-left.

documented_source_corrections.issue: A frozen-English proof branch changes E⇒E into C,E⇒C although the next sequent requires E on the right.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic correctly has C,E⇒E.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Replace C,E⇒C with C,E⇒E.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen English says G1c has not been shown immediately after presenting its proof; the outstanding system is G3c.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic names G3c.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Replace G1c with G3c in the transition sentence.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English conjunction-identity proof concludes B∧C⇒B after contraction although its stated goal is B∧C⇒B∧C.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic restores the conjunction on the right.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Make the final conclusion B∧C⇒B∧C.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English context assignment sets Pi=!B,Lambda while also setting Lambda=Delta; the displayed instance requires Pi=!B,Gamma.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic gives Pi=!B,Gamma.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Replace Pi=!B,Lambda with Pi=!B,Gamma.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen English claims height 4 while its own immediately following calculation gives proof height 2.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic states height 2.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Replace 4 with 2 in the prose claim.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English context substitution is written as a set comprehension and can collapse repeated formulas, although sequents use multisets.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic gives an occurrence-preserving multiset construction.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Define substitution occurrence-wise on the multiset, explicitly preserving multiplicity.

documented_source_corrections.issue: Two G3c universal-left inferences in the frozen English are labelled universal-right.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic uses universal-left in both places.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Change both labels to universal-left.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English preservation paragraph is grammatically garbled and leaves the substitution invariant unclear.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic states the invariant coherently and preserves the intended proof step.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Rewrite the paragraph to state explicitly that uniform replacement preserves each inference and the end sequent.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen English says there are no eigenvariable inferences above the chosen highest dirty inference; clean eigenvariable inferences may occur there.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic correctly says that every eigenvariable inference above it is clean.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Replace ‘no eigenvariable inferences’ with ‘no dirty eigenvariable inferences’ or ‘all eigenvariable inferences are clean.’

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English G1i table is labelled tab:G1c.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic uses tab:G1i.
documented_source_corrections.proposed_upstream_repair: Change the table label to tab:G1i.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English G3i disjunction-right premise has a multiple succedent Gamma⇒A,B, contrary to the system's at-most-one-succedent restriction.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English caption names G1m/G1i and labels the table tab:G3c although the table presents G3m/G3i.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic uses G3m/G3i and tab:G3i.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English LK caption omits Lambda from the sequent metavariables and labels the table tab:G1c.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English caption names mG1m/mG1i and labels the table tab:G3c although it presents mG3m/mG3i.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English disjunction proof tree contains an extra comma in a sequent.
documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic removes the extra comma.

documented_source_corrections.issue: The frozen-English truth-lemma proof begins under A∈Gamma and then introduces a case in which neither A nor negation A belongs to Gamma, making the case structure invalid.

documented_source_corrections.arabic_disposition: Arabic restores k².

terminology_decisions.sense: a rule whose conclusion derivability guarantees premise derivability without increasing height
terminology_decisions.rationale: قابلة للعكس is transparent and established in the current Arabic layer; it does not confuse proof-theoretic invertibility with logical contraposition.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Is قابلة للعكس the preferred academy usage for proof-theoretic rule invertibility, or should قابلة للقلب be standardized?

terminology_decisions.sense: a rule whose use does not enlarge the derivable sequents
terminology_decisions.rationale: مقبولة follows the inherited terminology, but ordinary Arabic can read it as socially accepted rather than metatheoretically admissible.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Which Arabic technical form most sharply distinguishes admissibility from derivability and primitive rulehood?

terminology_decisions.sense: the structural rule merging duplicate formula occurrences
terminology_decisions.rationale: التقلص directly evokes contraction and is consistent across the sequent-calculus section, but may be less conventional than الاختزال in some Arabic logic traditions.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Which term is standard for the structural contraction rule in Arabic proof theory, and should its noun and rule label use the same form?

terminology_decisions.sense: a collection preserving multiplicity but not order
terminology_decisions.chosen_arabic: مجموعة متعددة / متعددة المجموعات / متعددات مجموعات
terminology_decisions.rationale: The meaning is recoverable, but three grammatical realizations occur in a narrow span. This is the clearest internal consistency issue in the batch's technical vocabulary.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: What singular, dual/plural, and construct-state forms should be standardized for multiset in formal Arabic?

terminology_decisions.sense: the fresh variable governed by a quantifier-rule side condition
terminology_decisions.rationale: المميَّز describes the variable's special status without importing a foreign proper-name form, but does not by itself signal freshness.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Is المتغير المميَّز sufficiently standard and unambiguous for eigenvariable, or should the term explicitly mention freshness?

terminology_decisions.sense: a premise formula acted on by a rule, distinct from its principal formula
terminology_decisions.rationale: Both فاعلة and فعالة are intelligible, but the variation is terminologically undesirable because active and principal formula are formally defined roles.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Should active formula be standardized as الفاعلة or الفعالة, and which form best contrasts with الصيغة الرئيسة?

terminology_decisions.sense: a proof schema representing a family of concrete derivations
terminology_decisions.rationale: تخطيطي is concise and matches schematic, but may suggest an informal sketch rather than a parameterized proof schema.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Does برهان تخطيطي clearly denote a proof schema in Arabic mathematical logic, or is برهان بالمخطط preferable?

terminology_decisions.sense: a proof satisfying the stipulated eigenvariable cleanliness condition
terminology_decisions.rationale: منتظم is idiomatic and neutral, though the local technical definition—not the ordinary sense of orderly—must carry the precise meaning.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Is منتظم the standard equivalent of regular for eigenvariable-normalized proofs?

terminology_decisions.sense: a formal antecedent-succedent expression in sequent calculus
terminology_decisions.rationale: المتتالية is compact and consistently inherited, but in mainstream mathematics it often means a numerical sequence and may obscure the proof-theoretic sense.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Which academy-approved Arabic term best distinguishes a proof-theoretic sequent from an ordinary mathematical sequence?

terminology_decisions.sense: maximum number of inference steps on a branch
terminology_decisions.rationale: ارتفاع is transparent and works naturally with proof trees; adding شجرة may be more explicit but needlessly long in repeated notation.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Should height in proof theory be standardized as ارتفاع or علو?

terminology_decisions.sense: a systematic conversion of derivations between sequent systems
terminology_decisions.rationale: تحويل emphasizes structural conversion; ترجمة mirrors the source metaphor. The current text uses both senses intelligibly but a glossary should state whether they are synonyms.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Should derivation conversion between calculi be called تحويلًا, ترجمةً, or two distinct terms depending on context?

terminology_decisions.sense: consistent and not properly extendable while preserving consistency
terminology_decisions.rationale: The phrase preserves maximal rather than maximum, but is heavier than the adjectival alternatives.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Which Arabic form best preserves the order-theoretic sense of maximal consistency without suggesting greatest cardinality?

terminology_decisions.sense: finite satisfiability/entailment compactness in logic
terminology_decisions.rationale: التراص is common in Arabic topology and preserves the cross-disciplinary name; الانضغاط is also widespread in translated logic literature.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: For logical compactness, do the relevant official dictionaries prefer التراص or الانضغاط?

terminology_decisions.sense: assignment of truth values to propositional atoms/formulas
terminology_decisions.rationale: تقييم is transparent but can suggest an evaluative judgment; إسناد more explicitly denotes assignment.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Which term should be standard for valuation in formal semantics, especially when assignment is separately used for variables?

terminology_decisions.sense: true in at least one valuation/model
terminology_decisions.rationale: قابلة للإرضاء closely tracks the technical verb satisfy and aligns with the current token inventory; قابلة للتحقيق is more idiomatic but can blur satisfiability with realizability.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Do official Arabic logic dictionaries prefer الإرضاء or التحقيق for semantic satisfiability?

terminology_decisions.sense: from A and A→B infer B
terminology_decisions.rationale: الفصل is extremely compact and has a classical logical pedigree, but outside that tradition it is liable to be read as disjunction or chapter/section.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Is الفصل sufficiently unambiguous for modus ponens in a modern logic textbook, or should a descriptive form be preferred?

terminology_decisions.sense: countably infinite, not merely finite-or-countable
terminology_decisions.rationale: The expanded token states both infinitude and enumerability, preserving the distinction from countable. The wording is semantically clear though not necessarily the preferred academy phrase.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: What is the official Arabic equivalent of denumerable as distinct from countable?

terminology_decisions.sense: variables ranging over relations or functions, classified by number of argument places
terminology_decisions.chosen_arabic: متغيرات العلاقات والدوال في الرتبة الثانية؛ الرتبة للـarity
alternatives: متغيرات علائقية ودالية من الرتبة الثانية
terminology_decisions.rationale: The phrase is intelligible, but using رتبة both for logical order and arity risks a local terminological collision.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Should arity be rendered by عدد المواضع or حجية to avoid colliding with رتبة in second-order logic?

terminology_decisions.sense: a bijection preserving the relevant relational or functional structure
terminology_decisions.rationale: التشاكل is compact and widely recognizable in Arabic mathematics, while the descriptive alternatives make structure preservation explicit.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Is التشاكل the preferred official form across algebra, model theory, and set-structured examples?

terminology_decisions.sense: an operation with n argument places
terminology_decisions.rationale: n-موضعية is concise and avoids using رتبة, but its mixed-script hyphenation deserves typographic and terminological review.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Which Arabic formation is preferred for n-ary, and how should the variable n be integrated typographically in RTL prose?

terminology_decisions.sense: least set closed under stated base and constructor clauses
terminology_decisions.rationale: استقرائي connects the definition with its associated induction principle, but some traditions reserve استقراء for proof and use توليدي for definition.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Should inductive definition be standardized as تعريف استقرائي, تعريف بالاستقراء, or تعريف توليدي?

terminology_decisions.sense: informal/non-axiomatic treatment of sets before formal axiomatization
terminology_decisions.rationale: الساذجة is the literal conventional calque and contrasts with axiomatic set theory, but it can sound pejorative in ordinary Arabic.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: What term do official Arabic mathematical references prefer for naive set theory without an unintended pejorative tone?

terminology_decisions.sense: the proof pattern showing an arbitrary element satisfies an implication
terminology_decisions.rationale: The compact phrase mirrors the source label, but may be mistaken for the named conditional-proof rule in natural deduction.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Is البرهان الشرطي العام an established name for this elementwise pattern, or should the phrase be made descriptive?

terminology_decisions.sense: infer either conjunct from a conjunction
terminology_decisions.rationale: حذف is compact and mirrors elimination, but can imply deleting information rather than deriving a conjunct.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Should elimination rules use حذف or إزالة consistently, and is a descriptive extraction phrase preferable pedagogically?

terminology_decisions.sense: derive the same conclusion from both disjunctive cases
terminology_decisions.chosen_arabic: حذف الرابط ∨؛ تقسيم البرهان إلى حالات
terminology_decisions.rationale: The current text helpfully explains the proof move rather than relying only on a rule name; the relation between حذف and the traditional term فصل still needs standardization.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: What paired terms should be used consistently for disjunction and disjunction elimination in Arabic logic?

terminology_decisions.sense: classification of sets by whether their elements can be put into a suitable enumeration
terminology_decisions.rationale: قابل للعد is transparent, but must remain terminologically distinct from the stronger denumerable phrase used in OLP-0716.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Which official pair should be used for countable/uncountable while preserving the distinction from denumerable?

terminology_decisions.sense: the structural rule adding formulas to a sequent context
terminology_decisions.rationale: الإضعاف is semantically transparent and consistent with the inherited rule names; التوهين appears in other technical domains.
terminology_decisions.expert_question: Is الإضعاف the standard proof-theoretic term for weakening in Arabic sequent calculus?
